differences.title: 1. STORAGE MODEL
differences.leftDesc: Prometheus uses a custom TSDB optimized for time-series data, storing data per-metric and per-label set for efficient querying and aggregation.
differences.rightDesc: VictoriaMetrics employs a key-value store with a time-series index, optimizing for high ingest rates and low query latency by indexing data efficiently.

differences.title: 2. DATA COMPRESSION
differences.leftDesc: Prometheus uses Snappy compression for its on-disk data, balancing compression ratio with CPU overhead for efficient storage and retrieval.
differences.rightDesc: VictoriaMetrics utilizes advanced, multi-layered compression algorithms, achieving higher compression ratios than standard methods, significantly reducing storage footprint.

differences.title: 3. CLUSTERING & HA
differences.leftDesc: Prometheus often relies on federation or remote write to external systems for clustering and high availability, centralizing data management.
differences.rightDesc: VictoriaMetrics offers built-in clustering and replication, providing native horizontal scalability and high availability for both data ingest and querying.

differences.title: 4. QUERY LANGUAGE
differences.leftDesc: Prometheus uses PromQL, a powerful and expressive query language designed for its time-series data model, enabling complex aggregations.
differences.rightDesc: VictoriaMetrics uses MetricsQL, an enhanced PromQL-compatible language offering additional functions and optimizations for performance and efficiency.

differences.title: 5. RESOURCE USAGE
differences.leftDesc: Prometheus can be more resource-intensive, especially with many time series, due to its TSDB architecture and query processing.
differences.rightDesc: VictoriaMetrics is engineered for high performance with lower memory and CPU consumption, excelling in high-volume, high-cardinality environments.

differences.title: 6. SINGLE BINARY
differences.leftDesc: Prometheus typically involves multiple components (server, agent, etc.) that need separate management and deployment.
differences.rightDesc: VictoriaMetrics provides a single, self-contained binary for its core components, simplifying deployment, configuration, and management.

differences.title: 7. GLOBAL VIEW
differences.leftDesc: Achieving a global view in Prometheus often requires setting up federation or using remote write to a central system.
differences.rightDesc: VictoriaMetrics offers a native global query view across all its nodes, simplifying aggregation and analysis of metrics from distributed sources.
